text:
mira: Quick heads-up — nightly kv-cache report shows a ~20% absolute hit-rate drop for shard-7 after last night's shard-rebalancer rollout. Eviction rate up ~3x. Can someone run a focused hit/eviction scan? :eyes:

dan: I noticed that too on the dashboards. Might be fragmentation after the split. Do we have the perf snapshot?

perf-bot: nightly-kv-snapshot uploaded: s3://redwood-ci/kv-snap/1812345678.json — per-shard summary: shard-7 hit_rate=48% (prev 70%), evictions=3.1x, free_frag=12.4%

mira: thanks. Joel — can you run a quick kv-scrub on shard-7 with a 1h window and dump the sample? Command I used locally:```
./tools/kv-scrub --shard=7 --window=1h --out=tmp/shard7-scan.json
```

joel: running now, will attach the small JSON. ETA ~3m. If it's fragmentation we should see a lot of tiny allocations in the free list. Also will capture p99 latency per key-length bucket.

joel: (output) scan complete — sample metrics: hit_rate=0.49, evictions_last_1h=12.3k, free_frag_ratio=0.125, p99_lat=18ms. Attached tmp/shard7-scan.json to thread.

tara: pinging @eng-sre and @dan — could the new ranking model rollout that increases long-prefix queries be shifting the hotset? I saw a small uptick in avg-prefix-length on the request traces.

dan: good call. I correlated request types: shard-7 is servicing a few traffic pins for the EU cluster which got the experiment. But the majority of misses are short prefixes (<=8 tokens) which points more to placement/fragmentation than workload change.

mira: created issue #7269 with the scan + snapshot links. Proposal: 1) run a defrag sweep on shard-7 in dry-run, 2) if that improves hit-rate, schedule a targeted defrag maintenance window, 3) revert rebalance config if defrag doesn't help.

joel: I can run a dry-run defrag:```
./tools/kv-defrag --shard=7 --dry-run --sample=10000
```
Dry-run shows potential recovered capacity ~9% and expected hit bump ~6-8% (estimate). I'll queue a real defrag during the 03:00 UTC maintenance slot if we agree.

perf-bot: scheduled defrag-dryrun job job-id=kv-defrag-1812345-dry at 2026-03-18T02:45:00Z.

mira: sounds good. @dan can you review PR #5123 (rebalance tweak) — if defrag doesn't meet threshold we'll revert that change asap. Also please review the scrub/defrag tooling logs when you have a minute.

dan: will review in the next hour. Thanks all — keep this thread updated after the maintenance run. :thumbsup:
